name: mirage
text: Found the cause (read-only, no code touched yet). Both Pinnacle sources, PinnWire and pinnapi, report to the scan under ONE feed id, 'pinnacle'. So the pinnapi card shows the whole Pinnacle result (PinnWire answered, so green 'working') even though all 3 pinnapi keys are refused (403). PinnWire's card has no feed of its own, so it stays grey even though it works (11 keys active). Fix plan, written to TASKS.md as AS1-AS3: (1) the engine reports which host answered, so each card is judged separately; (2) a card whose keys are all refused is never green; (3) a 'X is working again' message in Messages when an API that failed answers again (BoltOdds included). I'll wait for the other session's Kalshi work to land before touching the app code, then do it.
